job: Rank items by size: credits by endpoint, requests by key.
purpose: A list for a ranking: label left, a thin bar, the figure right in mono. It is plain CSS driven by one custom property per row, --value, a fraction from 0 to 1 of the longest row. Below 320px the bar drops under its label. The fill grows once when scrolled into view.
useWhen: A ranking of a few to a dozen items with exact figures.
Parts of a total where order matters more than proportion.
Each figure is shown beside the previous period's (432, was 401).

avoidWhen.when: Parts of a whole with two to five segments.

states.name: entering
states.how: data-enter pending, run or done; the fill grows once when the list scrolls into view

variants.useWhen: A bar the one series that matters, in the accent.
A bar in ink when the accent is spoken for.

parts.role: A tick on the track at the previous value, --was on the same scale as --value.
The previous value written after the figure ("was 401").
